kerygmachela.verified_scope: 2018 results specify11 flap pairs, maximum fourth/fifth,11 axial rows of4 tubercles, single unsegmented median tail, ventrolateral kidney/sickle eye lobes under appendage bases. Mouth lies beneath anterior lobe, flanked by rostral spines.

pambdelurion.primary: Young and Vinther2017 author copy plus Vinther et al.2016 original full text
pambdelurion.original_pixels: 2017 printedpp34,36,38 show actual specimen plates Fig6(MGUH31530/24.577/31531/31532), Fig8(MGUH31533), Fig10(MGUH31532). Fig10 has reflective external flap outline. Printedpp35/39 are schematic Fig7/11, explicitly not original pixels of a whole animal.
pambdelurion.verified_scope: 2017 supports soft annulated body, lobopod musculature and flaps;11 paired flaps/legs and short paired posterior lobes are the explicit author reconstruction rather than countable on every incomplete plate.2016 original description independently read through web confirms ventral oral anatomy, paired sets of3 cephalic spines and annulated frontal appendages. About16 triangular oral plates is an inference from13–14 preserved, not an invariant count.2017 sample30–339mm is not the2016 maximum complete460mm/estimated550mm.
pambdelurion.concept_corrections: Concept has a forward conical nose; frozen brief correctly requires a restrained ventral oral region. Not importing Kerygmachela eyes/tail.
pambdelurion.limits: 2016 original pixels were not obtained or claimed inspected;2017 actual whole-body specimens were independently inspected. The2016 web text is identified by exact source URL, not falsely assigned a local downloaded-file hash.

aegirocassis.primary: Van Roy et al.2015 main article, original figures and supplementary descriptionpp1–3
aegirocassis.original_pixels: Fig1 holotypeYPM237172 fossil with interpreted dorsal/ventral flaps and displaced carapace; Fig2YPM527125 has preserved podomeres and long setose filter structures. Fig3 is artwork.
aegirocassis.verified_scope: Early Ordovician. Supplement describes11 trunk segments including blunt terminal,10 flap-bearing segments, paired dorsal and ventral flap levels,7 podomeres and5 long filtering spines per appendage, shortened proximal comb spine and terminal downturned tip. At least70–80 setae reported; fine secondary spinules can be omitted as declared. Complete7-podomere appendage around12cm, not a giant predatory grasper. Eyes unpreserved and inferred. YPM237172 preserves9 segments, total1.6–1.7m is reconstructed.
aegirocassis.concept_corrections: Concept proportions and five-endite geometry are not evidence. Frozen brief correctly supersedes outsized support appendages and keeps large elongate carapace and two flap sets.

arthropleura.verified_scope: Target juvenileSOT002123 body39.8mm, unknown species,24 dorsalunits including small wingless collum and terminal region.38 legpairs preserved;6 pairs forT12–14 inferred to44.8 podomeres include claw. Head mostly under collum;stalked eyes without preserved ommatidia.7 antennal articles is study-level CT finding, most clearly based onSOT002118 Fig5B as text says, not a claim that every article is visible inSOT002123 Fig2.
arthropleura.concept_corrections: Generated concept has broad wings on collum and round beads for eyes. Original brief rejects these; juvenile scope fixed before geometry, no adultA.mammata or2.6m inference.
